decisions.reason: A cheap accessory that ties up few resources and complements the trailer range, so with no evidence of a shortfall there is little reason to start problemistic search, though its absence from the website since 2019 adds some uncertainty.
A core box trailer line that was featured on the home page and likely met aspirations during the strong pandemic-era demand for trailers, so it is retained.
A niche car transporter line whose results remain uncertain, but the firm's slack lets it carry the line while evidence accumulates.
A low-bed series close to the firm's core competencies with no sign of performance falling below aspiration.
A high-cover series that broadens the core range and was prominently featured, so the firm keeps it.
A second box trailer series that may overlap with B and could be consolidated, but without evidence of a shortfall it is kept for now.
